whatTheyArgued: No work claimed. Historical record (HistoryNet, SPR summary, search results): Scientific American's committee offered prizes (1922) for demonstrable psychic manifestations; Houdini sat on it as a skeptic, attended the July 1924 Margery seances, explained how her effects could be done by ordinary means and built a restraining cabinet; the prize was not awarded.

scholarship.supports: SciAm offered the prize, Houdini was a committee member, explained her methods, prize declined
scholarship.disputes: I did not read scholarship on whether Houdini fairly treated Margery (accounts of him quarreling with the committee exist); the compendium's onstage re-performance claim is unverified by me.

ourUse: houdiniExclusivity re-runs isMetaSentence (a regex-style test) over the finished piece and folds out sentences that sound like the mouth talking about its own phrasing or task. fold-chat-houdini.js (the same archon, a second organ) projects the fold's context by need and by moment: records that bear on the ask, pinned records (unsupported or open) first, a hard cap at the positional size, an honest 'Not shown: N' count. Measured by eval/houdini (docs/HOUDINI.md).

bends.ours: 'He backed a standing, public prize (via Scientific American)'.
bends.theirs: The prize was Scientific American's committee's; Houdini was a member, not its sponsor, and the Margery prize was a specific 1922-24 committee offer.

bends.ours: 'checked for the mechanism that actually produced it', 'show the mechanism live'.
bends.theirs: Houdini reproduced effects and exposed method on specific mediums; the code pattern-matches a sentence for self-reference and has no access to its true mechanism.

bends.ours: work cites 'not by declaring a seance false, but by attending one, then performing the same effect himself ... onstage'.
bends.theirs: The compendium itself says this was recalled from general knowledge; I verified attendance and explaining her tricks, not onstage re-performance.

bends.ours: fold-chat-houdini.js: 'what the audience is shown is chosen in advance, to the moment, and nothing else is on the stage'.
bends.theirs: Houdini's writings on conjuring and exposure (The Unmasking of Robert-Houdin, A Magician Among the Spirits) do not address choosing what a reader or model is shown; the name stands for the discipline only, no argument of his is applied.

noBendReason: The handle is a project nomination claiming no Houdini text; the bends are about the historical gloss in the compendium and how far the code resembles his method. The context-projection organ is likewise a nomination: it applies no text of his.
